shop.name: Felu Modak
shop.location: Srimani Lane, G.T. Road, Rishra, Hooghly, West Bengal
shop.story: For over 175 years, Felu Modak has preserved the pure artisanal tradition of Bengal's confectionery craft, balancing heritage recipes with modern automated standards.

menu.name: Mohini Sandesh (Jolbhora)
menu.description: Felu Modak's custom liquid-filled sweet. Made from fresh, hand-kneaded chhana and filled with a liquid syrup center of fresh Nolen Gur (winter palm jaggery) or rose syrup depending on the season.

sensoryNotes.texture: Granular, soft exterior with a sudden burst of liquid syrup core

menu.name: Saffron Rabri
menu.description: Thickened cow milk slow-simmered in shallow iron pans, layered with rich cream malai folds and infused with Kashmiri saffron, almonds, and pistachios.

menu.name: Heritage Gaja
menu.description: Felu Modak's world-famous Gaja. Multi-layered dough fried in pure ghee until crisp, then soaked in thick cardamom sugar syrup to create an exquisite crispy outer glaze and soft interior.

sensoryNotes.texture: Extremely crispy and flaky layers, juicy sweet interior

menu.name: Chhanar Polao
menu.description: A dry, delicate dessert made of tiny fried paneer globules resembling fine rice grains, lightly sweetened and tossed with saffron, raisins, and cashew nuts.

sensoryNotes.texture: Fine, loose, separate granules with a soft bite

timeline.title: The Founding Stall
timeline.description: Felu Charan De establishes a small sweet shop in Rishra, Hooghly, serving fresh hand-pressed sandesh to travelers along the historical Grand Trunk Road.

timeline.title: Creating the Mohini Sandesh
timeline.description: Felu Modak builds its renown by introducing the 'Mohini Sandesh' (their premium adaptation of the liquid-filled Jolbhora) using wood-carved jackfruit-wood molds.

timeline.title: Patronage of Leaders
timeline.description: Mahatma Gandhi, Rabindranath Tagore, and Subhas Chandra Bose praise the purity and artisanal taste of Felu Modak's sweets during their visits to Hooghly.

timeline.title: The Next-Gen D2C Brand
timeline.description: Felu Modak transitions into a national D2C brand, combining 175 years of heritage recipes with premium cold-chain delivery.
